runtime_reachability_summary.notes: Under the owner-authorized plan supersession, doom.ts imports src/vanilla/runDoomMain.ts and is no longer an `export {}` skeleton. runDoomMain wires the vanilla command-line + launch-context surface, transitively reaching the src/bootstrap/ subsystem (cmdline, gameMode, IWAD discovery). The remaining src/ subsystems are pulled in progressively as the launch-host-input lane fleshes out the runDoomMain D_DoomMain/D_DoomLoop body.
